lesson.title: Everyday Actions & Chores
lesson.subtitle: Cleaning, carrying, brushing, closing, and daily habits
lesson.description: Describe everyday physical actions, household chores, routines, and using or sharing objects.

learning_objectives: Describe chores and hygiene: 打扫, 扫, 刷, 洗澡, 起, and 习惯.
Talk about handling objects: 搬, 带, 放, 关, 丢, 查, 分开, 养, and 用.
Describe physical movements: 爬, 跳, and 站.

metadata.audience: HSK 3.0 Level 3 learners with Level 1-2 foundations

overview.topic_description: Action verbs for physical movement, chores, routines, and handling everyday things.
overview.focus: Use 习惯 both as a verb ("be used to") and a noun ("habit"), and place objects after 把 with 放 or 搬.

questions.prompt: What does Grandpa do right after getting up at 6:30?
questions.answer: He stands on the balcony for a bit, then brushes his teeth and washes his face.
questions.explanation: The passage says 先在阳台站一会儿，再刷牙洗脸.

questions.prompt: Write two sentences about your daily routine or chores using 习惯 and 打扫 or 带.
questions.answer: 我习惯周末打扫屋子，出门时也会带着水瓶子。
questions.explanation: Use 习惯 and 打扫/带 naturally.
打扫 means to clean or sweep.
养 means to raise or keep animals/plants.

questions.prompt: Which verb means "to lose / throw away"?
questions.explanation: 丢 means lose or throw away.

dialogue.title: Weekend Housework
dialogue.context_en: Two roommates divide up chores before guests arrive.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 客人下午就到了，咱们先把屋子打扫一下吧！
turns.pinyin: Kèrén xiàwǔ jiù dào le, zánmen xiān bǎ wūzi dǎsǎo yíxià ba!
turns.english: The guests arrive this afternoon—let’s clean the room first!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 没问题，我负责扫地，你把桌子上的书搬到书架上放好。
turns.pinyin: Méi wèntí, wǒ fùzé sǎodì, nǐ bǎ zhuōzi shàng de shū bān dào shūjià shàng fàng hǎo.
turns.english: No problem, I’ll sweep the floor, and you move the books on the table onto the bookshelf.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 好，别忘了把旧报纸和纸盒分开，等会儿拿去楼下丢掉。
turns.pinyin: Hǎo, bié wàng le bǎ jiù bàozhǐ hé zhǐhé fēnkāi, děnghuìr ná qù lóuxià diū diào.
turns.english: Okay, don’t forget to separate the old newspapers and cardboard boxes to throw away downstairs in a bit.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 打扫完我再去洗个澡，然后咱们就准备做饭！
turns.pinyin: Dǎsǎo wán wǒ zài qù xǐ ge zǎo, ránhòu zánmen jiù zhǔnbèi zuòfàn!
turns.english: After cleaning I’ll go take a shower, and then we’ll get ready to cook!

patterns.title: Being used to something with 习惯
patterns.explanation_en: Use 习惯 (xíguàn) before a verb or noun to mean "be accustomed to", or as a noun for "habit".

examples.hanzi: 我已经习惯每天早上七点起床了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng xíguàn měitiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng le.
examples.english: I am already used to getting up at 7 a.m. every day.

examples.hanzi: 晚上刷牙是一个好习惯。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnshang shuāyá shì yí ge hǎo xíguàn.
examples.english: Brushing your teeth at night is a good habit.

patterns.title: Putting or moving something somewhere
patterns.explanation_en: Combine 把 + object + 放 / 搬 + 在 / 到 + location.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ yǔsǎn fàng zài mén pángbiān.
examples.english: Please put the umbrella beside the door.

examples.hanzi: 我们一起把那张桌子搬到客厅里。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ bǎ nà zhāng zhuōzi bān dào kètīng lǐ.
examples.english: Let’s move that table into the living room together.

paragraphs.hanzi: 爷爷今年七十多岁了，但是身体非常健康。他每天早上六点半准时起来，先在阳台站一会儿，再刷牙洗脸。

paragraphs.pinyin: Zǎofàn yǐhòu, tā xíguàn dài zhe xiǎo gǒu qù fùjìn sànbù, yǒu shíhou hái huì pápa xiǎoshān, huòzhě bāng jiālǐ dǎsǎo yuànzi.
paragraphs.english: After breakfast, he is used to taking his dog for a walk nearby, and sometimes climbs the small hill or helps sweep the courtyard at home.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Describe one good daily habit you have using 习惯.

model_answer.hanzi: 我习惯每天晚上睡前看半个小时书。
model_answer.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn měitiān wǎnshang shuìqián kàn bàn ge xiǎoshí shū.
model_answer.english: I am used to reading for half an hour before bed every night.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Say what chores you do at home using 打扫, 扫, or 搬.

model_answer.hanzi: 周末我会打扫自己的屋子，还会把垃圾拿出去丢掉。
model_answer.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ huì dǎsǎo zìjǐ de wūzi, hái huì bǎ lājī ná chūqù diū diào.
model_answer.english: On weekends I clean my own room and take the trash out to throw away.

teaching_plan.common_pitfall: 丢 (diū) means both "lose / misplace" (丢了钥匙) and "throw away" (丢垃圾). Context makes the meaning clear.
teaching_plan.pronunciation_focus: 打扫 (dǎsǎo) has two consecutive third tones, so 打 shifts to a rising second tone (dásǎo) in speech; 洗澡 (xǐzǎo) likewise shifts to xízǎo.

can_do: Describe chores like 打扫, 扫, and 搬.
Talk about habits and routines with 习惯 and 洗澡.
Use action verbs like 爬, 跳, 站, 放, and 关.
